methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops targeting technology gap closure in Hampton Roads signals grassroots capability-building and distributed access, though sustainability depends on whether these spark peer learning networks or remain isolated interventions.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab in Southwest Virginia represents institutional investment in deep AI literacy outside metro hubs, testing whether regional anchor institutions can distribute capability beyond NoVA's gravitational pull.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership signals Richmond Metro's attempt to build concentrated AI expertise and innovation capacity, potentially creating a secondary hub but not yet demonstrating mechanisms for broader statewide distribution.

signals.title: Meta, Google invest in skilled worker training to build Virginia data centers - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Meta and Google investing in skilled worker training for data center operations suggests platform companies enabling shallow, task-specific AI adoption—workers trained to maintain infrastructure rather than develop deep AI capability.

signals.title: Column: AI can help dyslexic learners build career readiness - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: AI tools for dyslexic learners exemplify platform-delivered accessibility solutions that broaden access through ready-made applications, creating wide but shallow adoption without requiring deep technical fluency from end users.
